adoption_rule.a_complete: all five comparison fits completed in all four senses (training completed, worker exit 0, artifacts persisted, host acknowledgment uploaded), replayed under pmm-v3-replay-1, with verified durable copies; each fit's optimizer has the control's two parameter groups with the trunk group at initial learning rate 1e-4 and the base group at 3e-5; the five controls equal the evidence bound by the launch manifest and reproduce the A4 fold values
adoption_rule.b_interval: both unadjusted 95% lower bounds of T1 (folds 0-4) above zero: fold bootstrap (percentile, 10,000 resamples, seed 42) and t interval with 4 degrees of freedom
adoption_rule.decision: a promising candidate for further confirmation only if (a), (b), (c), (d) and (e) all hold; otherwise the reference is retained, with every failed condition named by class and magnitude

comparison.candidate: the five fits with GVP-trunk learning rate 1e-4
comparison.control: the five verified fits of the v3-selected cell (fold 0: the reused step-B full-fp32 run)
comparison.estimand: mean over folds 0-4 of the paired common-four balanced-accuracy differences (candidate minus control)
comparison.metric: common-four balanced accuracy at the terminal checkpoint

excluded: a final refit or any held-out evaluation
a second assessment of the same fits with changed rules
interpretation: Exploratory development evidence: all five folds were already used for the v3 selection and one training seed (42) is used. Passing marks a promising candidate for further confirmation; it does not establish independently confirmed superiority or robustness across seeds. The controls were selected on these folds, so their values may be optimistic, which works against the candidate. A failed rule means the reference (74.28%) is retained, not that the trunk learning rate cannot help.

outcomes.blocked: a fit failed after its one unchanged rerun: no decision; the reference is retained unless the user decides otherwise
outcomes.promising_candidate: the 1e-4 GVP-trunk learning rate is a promising candidate for further confirmation; the v3 selection, its refit and its test result are unchanged
outcomes.reference_retained: the v3-selected configuration (GVP-trunk learning rate 3e-4) remains the reference

sensitivity.method: T1 recomputed on folds 1-4 (paired intervals with 3 degrees of freedom)
sensitivity.role: reported as sensitivity; only its mean enters the rule, through (e)

single_change: --gvp-learning-rate 1e-4 instead of 3e-4: the GVP trunk group (GVP layers and node/edge scalar encoders) starts at 1e-4 under the same cosine schedule; base learning rate 3e-5, optimizer group membership, weight decay, epochs, inputs, folds, class weights, seed, precision and lane settings are the controls'
stopping_rule: exactly the five listed fits; a failed fit gets one unchanged rerun (same seed and identity)
a second failure blocks the decision
one assessment, after all five fits are verified
no automatic refit, test evaluation or follow-up sweep
